name: knowledge-lint
description: Semantic pass over the store: cluster near-duplicates, consolidate each cluster preserving every detail, and archive the originals. Cadenced by write count, not the clock.

apply.help: Write the consolidated items and archive their inputs. Off by default: the plan is the artifact, and a pass that both decides and writes gives you nothing to review.

min_cluster_size.help: Smallest group worth one model call. Below about five, a summary loses more than it saves.

metadata.why_metered: One model call per cluster, capped per pass, so marginal cost does not grow with the store.
metadata.run_after_reason: Linting a stub spends a model call to discover it is a stub. Health finds those for free.
metadata.cadence: mutation-count (default every ~12 writes), not wall clock — a store nobody wrote to does not need linting.

steering_examples.description: Show me what a consolidation pass would merge, but don't write anything yet.
Cluster 2 mixes two different topics — drop it and apply the rest.

example_outputs: near-duplicate knowledge items merged into one, originals archived

config.prompt:
{{item.prompt}}

Return ONE consolidated item. Preserve every distinct detail from the inputs; if two inputs disagree, record both with their sources rather than choosing. Do not add anything the inputs do not contain.

children.label: Did the merge keep every distinct detail?
